Plot source functional windowed RQA trajectories and optional ensemble mean

etr_plot_windowed_rqa_trajectories.Rd

Inspect frozen Python 1.2 scientific plotting geometry without recomputing any recurrence, RQA or transfer-entropy estimator. Original native R plots and numeric outputs remain the default.

Usage

etr_plot_windowed_rqa_trajectories(result, metric, show_mean = FALSE,
  max_curves = NULL, strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

result

Native precomputed functional windowed RQA trajectories.

metric

Existing functional RQA metric dimension.

show_mean

Logical scalar determining whether the across-curve mean is shown.

max_curves

Optional positive count limiting individual plotted trajectories, not the population contributing to the mean.

strict_source_record

Return source scientific artist coordinates with metric units and curve transparency when TRUE.

...

Legacy base R graphics options.

Value

Invisibly the original time grid, selected individual curves, and optional full-ensemble mean by default. Strict mode yields typed native per-curve 0.45-alpha lines, optional 2.2-width mean, original metric unit label, and conditional legend.

Details

Strict mode represents bounded source-scientific coordinates as native R records; Python dataclass and pandas domain identity, exception types, full Matplotlib Axes return, pixel rendering and independent full-source certification are not claimed.
